note: Meter Reader demo rig sources and their routes (SPEC 14.2, PRD 9.1). One Datagen Source per data stream, one route per Source at the top of the default route table (filter __inputId=='datagen:<id>', final). targetGbPerDay is the PRD 9.1 design rate; rateFactor is the fraction of it the free-tier Worker sustains (measured, see docs/RIG.md). eventsPerSec = targetGbPerDay x rateFactor x 1e9 / 86400 / bytesPerEvent / workerNodes (Datagen rates are per Worker Node). GB = 1e9 bytes. datagenSampleField names which sample-library field a Datagen's samples[].sample holds (the sample id: the samples.yml key and the data/samples/<id>.json file name).
